field_notes.mount_key: the data-composition-id / window.__timelines key the installed file actually declares. Mount the block with THIS, not the slug. Never null: every one of the 154 resolves.
field_notes.matches_slug: false means the docs' own usage snippet (which uses the slug) will not match the file
field_notes.mount_key_dynamic: true for the 9 blocks with no literal __timelines["..."]; they register via a variable holding their own declared id. mount_key is still correct - see mount_key_reason
field_notes.install_files: total files written by the install, composition file included
field_notes.needs: gsap is universal. three/d3/topojson are CDN unless three_source says otherwise. html-in-canvas is the experimental layoutSubtree/drawElementImage API - no polyfill exists
field_notes.local_lib: present only when the block loads a locally-installed runtime script that must survive install
field_notes.render_time_network: block fetches data over the network during render - fails on an offline render host
field_notes.var_count: variables the file actually declares, from either declaration form
field_notes.doc_shows_interpolation_artifact: the published page renders a literal " ' + compositionId + ' " as a composition id; a reader copying it gets a broken string
